result:
Summary: For the calendar week of April 6 to April 10, 2026, the sources indicate that the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics will release the U.S. Import and Export Price Indexes for March 2026 on Wednesday, April 15, at 08:30 AM, and Metropolitan Area Employment and Unemployment (Monthly) for January 2026 along with Usual Weekly Earnings of Wage and Salary Workers for the First Quarter 2026 on Thursday, April 16, at 10:00 AM. The Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED) calendar lists several releases, including Moody's Daily Corporate Bond Yield Averages at 10:15 am, G.17 Industrial Production and Capacity Utilization at 11:15 am, and others throughout the day. The Federal Reserve System meeting calendar does not list any meetings during this week. The New York Fed economic indicators calendar does not provide specific releases for this week.
